HUMAN REVIEW

Safety Review

Automatic flags help a coach or administrator find concerning language. They do not replace human judgment or emergency procedures.

What should I choose?Reviewed — checked; no further action is needed.Dismiss — a false alert or a test.Escalate — a real concern needing follow-up.Ending a Guardian Safety Test clears its test-only alerts automatically while preserving the audit history.
